item.title: Ginga no Uo Ursa Minor Blue
item.description: Ginga no Uo Ursa Minor Blue (Japanese: 銀河の魚 URSA minor BLUE; also romanized Ginga no Sakana and translated as Blue Little Bear Ursa Minor Blue or Fish of the Milky Way Ursa Minor Blue) is a 1993 Japanese animated science fiction short film written and directed by illustrator Shigeru Tamura, with music by Teshikai Utollo. The 23-minute film is an early work of digital animation and was produced using Macintosh Quadra computers and high-definition video. The film follows a boy named Yuri and his astronomer grandfather on a surreal journey along the Milky Way, where they encounter a monstrous fish attacking the constellations. Its imagery combines science fiction, fantasy and surrealism; The Encyclopedia of Science Fiction has characterized it as an example of absurdist science fiction. The film received the Ōfuji Noburō Award at the 1993 Mainichi Film Awards, as well as several other awards and distinctions at international and Japanese electronic-media and high-definition film festivals. Tamura later adapted the film into a picture book, while an interactive CD-ROM adaptation was published by Sony Music Entertainment Japan in 1994.
